📦 **meadow-food-frames-v2 `50eb1ecf`** — Revise food-grade art to thin rims and colored backgrounds

Replace bulky open frames with slate gray, wheat gold, jade green and plum panels, each with a narrow rim. Food sprites now overlay at the full32px size via Blockside528ca70. Preserve version1 masters/evidence and retain separate edited originals, prompts, SHA records and32px comparisons. Update the art specification and asset checker for an opaque center with transparent exterior.

Real globe -> built town UI verifies four grades at1200x900 and390x844,32px food above the backgrounds, no horizontal overflow and real404 fallback. Controlled meal records restored without saving. Asset checks, build AST/global/layer gates, srccheck d33eb380684efb97(188sources/42ship files) and shell check pass.

Refs TASK-1167
